description: Developed and maintained a business application for inventory and distribution platform using React, TypeScript, Next.js, GraphQL, Apollo Client, and Tailwind CSS.
Designed reusable frontend architectures using custom hooks, shared components, React Hook Form, Zod, and state management.
Built complex data-driven interfaces for inventory, sales, orders, stock movements, and internal transfers, including advanced filtering, pagination, forms, and dynamic tables.
Optimized GraphQL data fetching and client-side caching strategies to keep application state synchronized across multiple workflows.
Refactored legacy implementations into reusable and maintainable frontend modules, improving code consistency and reducing duplicated logic.
Collaborated with backend, design and product teams in Scrum environments to deliver new features and improve user experience.
Developed a React-based web platform for monitoring autonomous drone operations, including mission management, flight status, telemetry, and operational workflows.
Designed reusable UI components and documented them using Storybook, promoting consistency and maintainability across the application.
Built interactive data-driven interfaces including dashboards, maps, tables, calendars, and operational status views.
Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams throughout the planning, development, testing, and delivery of new product features.
Developed responsive web and mobile applications using Angular and Flutter, integrating backend functionality with Firebase Realtime Database and Firestore.
Managed application deployment and hosting across GitHub Pages, Firebase Hosting, and VPS environments.
